news.title: Xi Seeks Global AI Sway as Surging Chinese Models Spur Alarm
news.description: President Xi Jinping used the rise of China’s AI models to stake his claim on shaping the technology’s global rules, even as their growing power stirs security concerns in Washington and Beijing alike.

news.title: Has Nike lost its 'cool' factor? LeBron James weighs in
news.description: Nike's stock has slumped as the sportswear giant faces new competitors and waning influence. LeBron James has some advice on how to regain its 'cool' factor.

news.title: Netflix stock falls as earnings forecast disappoints, company says it will give fewer engagement updates
news.description: The streaming giant said it would cut back on the frequency of its "What We Watched" reports, which provide a picture of engagement.

news.title: DeepMind CEO to Lobby Washington on Plan for Group to Vet AI Models
news.description: Earlier this week, Google DeepMind Chief Executive Officer Demis Hassabis unveiled a proposal for a new international watchdog that would do “rigorous” tests and reviews of cutting-edge AI models before release.

news.title: DeepMind CEO Rallies Support for International Group to Vet AI Models
news.description: Demis Hassabis intends to hold meetings about his proposal with US policymakers.

news.title: 挚达科技发布家庭及公共场景自动充电机器人解决方案
news.description: 雷峰网获悉，挚达科技发布“AI能源+机器人”家庭及公共场景解决方案，以自动充电机器人为核心，结合光伏、储能、充电设备及AI平台，实现能源管理、任务调度和自动充电，面向家庭住宅及Robotaxi、物流车等公共运营场景。同时，挚达科技深圳公司正式揭牌，将承担产品研发、智能硬件研发及海外业务等职能。

news.title: Oil pipelines around the Strait of Hormuz won't end the threat Iran poses to Middle East crude exports
news.description: Oil producers are building or contemplating new pipeline projects to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, but this infrastructure is still vulnerable, analysts said.

news.title: Dallas Fed President Logan calls for 'modestly' higher interest rates
news.description: The policymaker said this week's good inflation news wasn't good enough.

news.title: Short sellers load up against SpaceX as stock drops below IPO price
news.description: About 185 million SpaceX shares are now sold short, representing roughly 29% of the company's publicly tradable float, according to S3.

news.title: 国产大芯片厂商“必修课”：从云豹智能看DPU赛道现实考题
news.description: 国内DPU厂商云豹智能6月30日向深交所递交创业板IPO材料，成为创业板第四套上市标准下首家申报的DPU芯片企业，被市场视作“国产DPU第一股”。而随着招股书披露经营数据，市场出现两类争议声音：连续三年归母净利润亏损和营收高度依赖单一大客户。

news.description:

news.title: Analysis: Fed Chairman Warsh faces an inflation credibility test after Congress hearings
news.description: The new Fed chairman avoided major stumbles in two days of testimony before the House and Senate, but faces a rapid test of his commitment to price stability.

news.title: 行业首个！中国一汽大模型入驻阿里云百炼，面向全行业开放
news.description: 7月15日，中国第一汽车集团有限公司（以下简称“中国一汽”）与阿里云智能集团联合宣布：由中国一汽基于千问自主研发的行业大模型已正式入驻阿里云百炼平台，面向全行业开放。作为业内首个实现商业化服务的大模型，它将中国一汽沉淀的行业know-how转化为标准化服务，让全行业企业都能低门槛调用专业AI能力。

news.title: 不改造门店机器人直接上岗，蚂蚁灵波智慧药房获WAIC 2026“镇馆之宝”
news.description: 2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC）将于7 月 17 日正式拉开帷幕。作为大会展览板块的最高荣誉，日前揭晓的十大“镇馆之宝”已率先成为各方关注的焦点。其中，蚂蚁集团的“基于蚂蚁灵波跨本体具身大模型的机器人智慧药房”，与中科曙光“曙光8000—全国产十万卡AI超集群”等硬核科技成果一同登榜。

news.title: Nvidia-backed Fireworks hits $17.5 billion valuation as companies pursue cheaper AI models
news.description: Fireworks once relied heavily on revenue from coding startup Cursor, but has diversified in the past year as more companies reach for lower-cost AI models.
